lines.en: Install this blog on your phone like an app

lines.ko: 처음 들어오면 화면 아래에 설치 안내가 뜹니다.
lines.en: On your first visit, an install prompt pops up at the bottom.
enLines: an install prompt pops up at the bottom.
lines.art: a small note sliding up from the bottom edge of a smartphone

lines.en: Tap it, and an icon lands on your home screen.
lines.art: a fingertip tapping a smartphone as a new app icon pops onto its home screen

lines.ko: 메뉴는 엄지가 닿는 화면 아래로 옮겼습니다.
lines.en: I moved the menu down where your thumb reaches.
The installed app opens with no address bar.
lines.art: a smartphone with a little door swinging open straight into a cozy room

lines.ko: 그런데 처음엔 아이콘이 브라우저 탭으로 열렸습니다.
lines.en: But at first, the icon opened a plain browser tab.

lines.ko: 뒤에서 도는 스크립트, 서비스 워커가 없었습니다.
lines.en: A script that runs in the background, the service worker, was missing.
enLines: A script that runs in the background,

lines.ko: 그러면 크롬은 앱 대신 바로가기만 만듭니다.
lines.en: Without it, Chrome makes only a shortcut, not an app.
enLines: only a shortcut, not an app.

lines.ko: 설명 그림을 넣은 쇼츠가 오늘 밤 잘 나오는지 봅니다.
lines.en: Tonight I'll watch if the shorts with new diagrams come out right.
enLines: Tonight I'll watch if the shorts
with new diagrams come out right.

lines.ko: 이미 깔았다면 지우고 다시 설치해 주세요.
lines.en: Already installed? Remove it and install it again.
enLines: Remove it and install it again.
